stories.title: New York’ta 3 saatlik kritik temas: ABD’li yetkililer İran heyetiyle görüştü

en.title: Critical 3-hour contact in New York: US officials met with Iranian delegation
en.summary: US officials and representatives from an Iranian delegation held a three-hour meeting in New York under President Trump's administration.

stories.title: FETÖ hükümlüsü Enver Altaylı’dan savcıya tehdit: Kendine dikkat et daha gençsin

en.title: FETÖ convict Enver Altaylı threatens prosecutor: Be careful, you are younger
en.summary: A convicted FETÖ member made threats toward a prosecutor during an investigation into the suspicious death of a former MIT official in Silivri Prison.

stories.title: Fon soruşturmasında Pusula ve Tera'nın 5 yöneticisi tutuklandı

en.title: 5 executives from Pusula and Tera arrested in fund investigation
en.summary: Five executives including the chairman of Tera Investment Holding were detained in connection with an investigation into fund-related activities.

stories.title: Sel nedeniyle çöken yolda çok sayıda araç hasar gördü

en.title: Multiple vehicles damaged on road that collapsed due to flooding
en.summary: Heavy rainfall in Ankara caused road collapses in the Keçiören district, damaging numerous vehicles.

stories.title: Ankara’da sağanak sonrası yol çöktü: Çok sayıda araç hasar gördü

en.title: Road collapsed after downpour in Ankara: Many vehicles damaged
en.summary: Heavy rain in Ankara's Keçiören district caused a road to collapse, damaging numerous parked vehicles. Emergency teams are working to rescue trapped vehicles at the scene.

stories.title: Fransa’nın kırmızı bültenle aradığı şüpheli Bodrum’da sahte kimlikle yakalandı

en.title: Suspect wanted by France with red notice arrested in Bodrum with fake identity
en.summary: Azed Eddine Trari, sought by France with a red notice, was arrested in Bodrum by police using false identity documents.

stories.title: Bodrum’da kırmızı bültenle aranan şüpheli sahte kimlikle yakalandı

en.title: Suspect wanted with red notice arrested in Bodrum with fake identity
en.summary: French national Azed Eddine Trari, wanted by France for organized crime, drug trafficking, and money laundering offenses, was arrested in Bodrum with fake identity and passport documents.

stories.title: ABD'li yetkililer İran heyetiyle görüştü... Trump: 'İran'la görüşme çok iyi geçti'

en.title: U.S. officials met with Iranian delegation... Trump: 'Meeting with Iran went very well'
en.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump announced that U.S. officials held a three-hour meeting with an Iranian delegation. Iran's state media reported that Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi presented conditions including lifting a naval blockade, releasing frozen Iranian assets, and ending conflict in resistance fronts.

stories.title: Fon soruşturmasında yeni gelişme: Emre Tezmen dahil 5 isim tutuklandı

en.title: New Development in Fund Investigation: 5 People Including Emre Tezmen Arrested
en.summary: Five individuals including Emre Tezmen were detained in connection with a Tera and fund investigation and subsequently ordered arrested by the court following judicial processing.

stories.title: Derbide Beşiktaş'ı devirdi: Cumhurbaşkanlığı Kupası'nda şampiyon Fenerbahçe Tarfin!

en.title: Fenerbahçe Tarfin Wins Presidential Cup Championship by Defeating Beşiktaş in Derby
en.summary: Fenerbahçe Tarfin defeated Beşiktaş 72-59 in the 39th Presidential Cup final, securing their second consecutive championship title.

stories.title: Aziz İhsan Aktaş'a suikast iddiasıyla tutukluydu! Tahliye edilen Selahattin Yılmaz'dan Bahçeli'ye ziyaret

en.title: Released from Custody on Assassination Allegation: Selahattin Yılmaz Visits Bahçeli
en.summary: Selahattin Yılmaz, who had been detained for approximately 13 months on charges of preparing an armed attack against Aziz İhsan Aktaş, was released from custody and visited a political figure.

stories.title: Borsa Manipülasyonu soruşturmasında yeni gelişme! Tera Holding yöneticisi Emre Tezmen tutuklandı

en.title: New Development in Stock Market Manipulation Investigation! Tera Holding Manager Emre Tezmen Arrested
en.summary: In a stock market manipulation investigation, five of 31 suspects detained in recent operations were referred to the judiciary, including Tera Yatırım Holding manager Emre Tezmen.

stories.title: Kanada, Filistin'e 100 milyon Kanada doları değerinde yardım yapacak

en.title: Canada to provide 100 million Canadian dollars in aid to Palestine
en.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney announced that Canada will provide assistance worth 100 million Canadian dollars, equivalent to approximately 73 million US dollars, to Palestine.

stories.title: Zelenskiy: Trump ve Putin'le görüşmeye hazırım

en.title: Zelenskiy: I am ready to meet with Trump and Putin
en.summary: Ukrainian President Volodimir Zelenskiy stated he is prepared for a three-way meeting with US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin. Zelenskiy indicated willingness for an energy ceasefire provided Russia ceases attacks on energy infrastructure.

stories.title: Erdoğan: Körfez'deki sıkıntıları aşmak için 8 ülke bir araya geldik

en.title: Erdoğan: Eight countries came together to overcome challenges in the Gulf
en.summary: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan stated that a meeting was held with the participation of approximately eight countries to address problems in the Gulf region. He expressed expectation that ongoing efforts would yield results soon.

en.title: Clinical research investment reaches 21.2 billion TL
en.summary: Clinical research investment in Turkey reached 21.2 billion TL in 2025 with a 24 percent increase, while the number of active studies grew 14 percent to 734. Volunteer participation and qualified employment in the sector also increased significantly.

stories.title: Erkan: Ağır finansman maliyetleri sektörün hızını frenliyor

en.title: Erkan: High financing costs are slowing down the sector
en.summary: The head of EGOD states that elevated financing costs and uncertainty are making investment decisions difficult for the automotive sector, while the growing share of electric and hybrid vehicles is accelerating the need for transformation in after-sales services.
